phase: Phase 4b: The live runs and the first track A results (by Sun 2026-11-22)
summary: Pass under the PM round cap only. All eleven test files pass. Eight nonblocking findings remain. The live path is not operationally ready.
nonblocking_findings: F12 [Major] review-a: Important for both live runs: session creation sends the wrong directory field. review-run.sh:1059 and judge-run.sh:805 send top-level directory, not location.directory. The live binary defaults an absent location to process.cwd(), which is /home/daniebo. The header does not change that handler. Thus the session misses the job root and its deny config. L1 and L11 assert the same incorrect request shape. Send location.directory, then verify the returned session location and effective denies. Route to Green.

F13 [Major] review-a: Important for both live runs: the review pass and probe do not wait for model completion. review-run.sh:1575 and :1700 pass a zero wait. The real prompt endpoint admits queued input; it does not return the completed answer. My empty-message fixture wrote a complete pass with a zero-byte output after one GET. A partial native answer also produced complete. judge-run.sh:979 returns on the first text part without checking time.completed or finish. Use one call deadline and await completion. Route to Green.

F14 [Major] review-a: Important for the token report: both synthesizers discard native token usage. review-run.sh:1177-1187 and judge-run.sh:923-933 read step-finish content entries only. The real assistant record carries tokens beside content, not inside content. My native completed-answer fixture recorded all token fields as zero and tokens_complete false. L4 tests invent step_finish message parts, so they pass without proving the live shape. Read native message.tokens and cover both runners. Route to Green.

F15 [Major] review-a: Important for the scheduled runs: both drivers omit BENCH_SERVER_BASE. probe-4.10.sh:13-16 and night-4.11.sh:13-16 set BENCH_QUOTA_BASE only. The transient service units also omit the new variable. The user manager currently has no BENCH_SERVER_BASE. review-run.sh:355-369 silently selects the isolated seed path without it, including pilot routes. Configure the caller and refuse a pilot invocation without the required live base. Route the driver configuration to the orchestrator and the fallback guard to Green.

F16 [Major] review-a: A failed message GET becomes success. review-run.sh:1211-1226 and judge-run.sh:957-972 assign rc=$? inside an if ! branch. That status is zero after negation. My extracted-function fixture returned failed_get_exit=0 from both copies when live_get_messages returned 1. The review probe can then report reachable after a failed read. Capture the original status and cover GET failures and timeouts. Route to Green.

F17 [Major] review-a: Native model errors disappear before classification. review-run.sh:1173-1194 and judge-run.sh:919-940 ignore message.error and finish. A native assistant with the Go region error produced a complete pass and an empty stored output in my fixture. A queued error need not appear in the prompt HTTP response. Preserve structured errors and classify region-blocked before accepting an answer. Add a native region-error probe case. Route to Green.

F18 [Major] review-a: The loopback guard accepts an external destination. review-run.sh:362-364 and judge-run.sh:317-319 accept http://127.0.0.1:38307@example.invalid. My extracted guard selected LIVE_PATH=1; URL parsing identifies example.invalid as the host. I sent no request. A caller can therefore send the private prompt outside loopback. Parse the URL and validate its actual hostname, port, and userinfo. Route to Green.

F19 [Nit] review-a: Several declared cases remain unproved. test-strategy.md:2329 requires missing, unreadable, and allowed-tool config refusals; review-run.test.ts:4907 tests only an allowed tool. The runner creates a missing config instead of refusing it. L5 at :5023 checks neither the exact timeout text nor exit 2. L7 at :5095 runs only a pass despite its pass/probe/judge title. Add the missing cases and reconcile the missing-config contract. Route tests to Green and the contract text to the orchestrator.
